decisions.rationale: Plant-wide ruling: FEED-PE-MAT-002 'Recommended MOC (base case)' governs material of construction over FEED-PE-MDL-001 (scale-up study) and design-note wording — MAT-002 is the controlled MoC matrix and postdates MDL-001. Wording variants of the same material family are superseded by the MAT-002 statement.
Four utility loops, not three (REP-043): add a ≥ 200 °C steam / thermal-oil loop for HX-601, the acid concentrator and R-141 heat-up; keep hot water, cooling water, chilled water.
decisions.gapNote: MoC on FEED-PFD-5000: add the ≥ 200 °C loop (A-5400 placeholder), move R-201 / R-303 exotherm control to chilled water, and derive all duties from the DBM V2.0 re-issued stream tables (D-A200-01, D-A300-01, D-A600-01); model the A-5000 packages (only TCU-201 / TCU-303 interfaces exist).

decisions.rationale: Hot water 80–95 °C recorded as the as-drawn basis; insufficient for the ≥ 160 °C users (F-51).
Chilled water 5–7 °C as drawn; carries the reactor exotherm control (coincident 2–3 of 4 R-201 dosing); calorimetry A-059 is the gating measurement.
Jacket-service duties follow D-A200-01 (R-201 basis) and D-A300-01 (T-303 Option B) — not approved here.

A-5400 heat supply basis (bases HS-1–HS-8, FEED-PE-NTE-014 / CAL-037): on the issued 1 wt % dryer feed HX-601 needs 13.8 MW rated and the A-1100 concentrator 3.5 MW — ≈ 17.4 MW against the 5–8 MW (10 MW provision) of MOC-002. With the HR-601 exhaust recuperator (air 25 → 50 °C, 2.7 MW) and MVR on concentrator stage 1, the users are 12.9 MW; A-5400 is 20 barg saturated steam from 2 × 7 MW gas-fired fire-tube boilers, 14 MW rated (≈ 24.6 t/h, 90 % condensate return, ≈ 2.5 t/h make-up). Thermal oil is the alternative; direct firing and electric heating are rejected. A FEED sizing basis for MOC-002 Part D — Part F (the decision on the change) is for the Approving Authority and is not signed. Approved in review by QFL 2026-09-27.

findings.topic: A-5400 placed in the future-expansion block (LAY-10 ruling L1, model catch-up release 3)
findings.status: Placed as a screening envelope — HAZOP and vendor footprint open
findings.observation: LAY-10 was ruled by QFL on 2026-09-29 (option L1, bases R3-1–R3-9) after a clear-space search of the current model (ground-level parts and walkways, 1 m clearance): A-1000 and A-2000 hold no 9 × 9 m pad even without the 20 retired tags, whose pipework and supports stay; the future-expansion block (x 105–116) and a south-east yard between the south pipe rack and the perimeter road (x 71–119, z −48…−34) are clear. A-5400 sits on a 10 × 18 m curbed pad at x 106–116, z −20…−2 with H-5400 (casing 3.6 × 10 m, ≈ 20 m stack), P-5401A/B, V-5401 on the heater structure and T-5401 (≈ 30 m³ screening). It is ≈ 27 m from the A-600 edge (DR-601 combustible dust), ≈ 14 m from the A-800 block edge (PY-801 hydrogen off-gas) and ≈ 17 m from the A-1100 acid bund — HAZOP inputs (U8), not a spacing ruling. Thermal-oil mains ≈ 60 m to HX-601 and ≈ 20 m to PK-1101 stage 2; the 0.14 MW R-141 heat-up via the A-5100 plate exchanger is ≈ 135 m away and is flagged for a rethink.
findings.action: Thermal-oil HAZOP with the heater location (U8, MOC-002 D.1 item 1); vendor footprint for the heater package; MOC-002 Part F; model engineer: oil mains and floor allocation.
